title: dryopteris hasseltii
intro: Dryopteris hasseltii, commonly known as Hasselt's shield fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a type of medicinal plant traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Dryopteris hasseltii include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities.
